prompt: If Anastasia Romanov had still been alive when the 90s cartoon movie based on her was released, how old would she be?
answer: If Grand Duchess Anastasia had survived until the release of the 1997 animated film, she would have been **96 years old**. She was born on June 18, 1901, and the film premiered in November 1997.
